C0551.title: Shanghai Changning Procuratorate Handled an Online Store Click-Farming Case Defrauding Platform Subsidies
C0551.summary: In June 2021, the Supreme People Procuratorate disclosed a false transaction case handled by the Shanghai Changning District People Procuratorate in which an online store attempted to defraud an e-commerce platform of subsidies. Fang operated a digital flagship store on the platform and, during the platform major subsidy campaign, colluded with customer service employee Wang, joined click-farming WeChat groups, instructed more than ten click workers to place fake orders, and used empty parcels to disguise the transactions, participating in an attempted fraud of more than 5.1 million yuan in platform subsidies. Because the platform risk controls detected anomalies and froze withdrawals, the subsidy fraud did not ultimately succeed, and Fang and Wang were both treated as attempted fraud offenders. In December 2020, Changning prosecutors charged Fang and others with fraud, and the court still imposed criminal penalties.

references.title: Targeting Telecom and Online Fraud: Criminals Exploit Loopholes in the E-Commerce Economy
